_comment: Tier-A autonomous auto-fix allowlist (Autonomous Auto-Fix PRD). A GitHub issue whose label appears in `labels` is auto-fixed on `dev` with NO human comment by the `advisor-autofix` job in .github/workflows/claude.yml. THREE mechanical, semantics-preserving lint classes are auto-fixable: `advisor-autofix` = unindexed_foreign_keys (create index if not exists); `advisor-autofix-rlsinit` = auth_rls_initplan (wrap bare auth.<fn>() in (select auth.<fn>()) with byte-identical predicates otherwise); `advisor-autofix-searchpath` = function_search_path_mutable (alter function ... set search_path = ''). SECURITY DEFINER / data-exposure findings (anon_ or authenticated_security_definer_function_executable, rls_enabled_no_policy, rls_policy_always_true, and anything else touching read authorization) are DELIBERATELY NOT auto-fixable and never get an autofix label — the in-job gate cannot prove read-authorization intent, and a wrong fix there exposes student data; those stay on the `@claude fix this` human gate. Any label NOT listed here stays on that human gate. Widening this list is a LOGGED decision (append docs/DECISIONS.md) — never a silent edit. maxAttempts caps auto-fix tries per issue before it escalates to human-only (`autofix-exhausted`); maxFiles caps the auto-fix blast radius (8, because one initplan finding can require re-creating several policies in a single migration).
